environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Access key id of an IAM user or role session in the AWS Marketplace seller account linked to Partner Central, with a policy such as AWSPartnerCentralOpportunityManagement (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/setup-authentication.html).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret access key of that IAM identity; never sent, used for the SigV4 signature.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token when the keys are temporary (assumed role / SSO); sent as X-Amz-Security-Token.
